```{r load_targets, echo=F, message=FALSE}
tar_load(protected_areas)
#tar_load(most_recent_fire.tif)
tar_load(park_fire_history)
# temp_directory is a pipeline constant (not a tar_target) — do not tar_load it.
tar_load(years_since_fire.tif)
tar_load(fires_wgs)
tar_load(most_recent_evi.tif)
tar_load(most_recent_evi_date)
tar_load(monthly_mean_evi.tif)
tar_load(monthly_delta_evi.tif)
tar_load(weather_data)
tar_load(mean_evi.tif)
tar_load(delta_evi.tif)
#tar_load(most_recent_quarter_evi_file)
#tar_load(quarterly_delta_evi.tif)
tar_load(stations)
tar_load(inat_data)

# Real weather gate (do not overwrite with FALSE after this — that was the
# #39/#40 merge bug that skipped station chunks and left focal_stations_sf unset).
# Empty weather.parquet is allowed by the envdata contract; skip climate work.
has_weather <- is.data.frame(weather_data) &&
  nrow(weather_data) >= 1L &&
  inherits(stations, "sf") &&
  nrow(stations) >= 1L

# Always seed empties so later map chunks can probe nrow() safely.
focal_weather <- tibble::tibble()
closest_stations <- character(0)
focal_stations_sf <- if (inherits(stations, "sf")) {
  stations[FALSE, , drop = FALSE]
} else {
  sf::st_sf(
    STNID = character(),
    NAME = character(),
    geometry = sf::st_sfc(crs = 4326)
  )
}
if (!has_weather) {
  message("No weather/station rows; skipping climate chunks for this park")
}

time_window_days=365
```

```{r data_prep, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,include=FALSE}
#Note that the "addLegend_decreasing" isn't quite right, but might be close enough if you feel strongly about the ordering

addLegend_decreasing <- function (map, position = c("topright", "bottomright", "bottomleft", 
			    "topleft"), pal, values, na.label = "NA", bins = 7, colors, 
		  opacity = 0.5, labels = NULL, labFormat = labelFormat(), 
		  title = NULL, className = "info legend", layerId = NULL, 
		  group = NULL, data = getMapData(map), decreasing = FALSE) {
	position <- match.arg(position)
	type <- "unknown"
	na.color <- NULL
	extra <- NULL
	if (!missing(pal)) {
		if (!missing(colors)) 
			stop("You must provide either 'pal' or 'colors' (not both)")
		if (missing(title) && inherits(values, "formula")) 
			title <- deparse(values[[2]])
		values <- evalFormula(values, data)
		type <- attr(pal, "colorType", exact = TRUE)
		args <- attr(pal, "colorArgs", exact = TRUE)
		na.color <- args$na.color
		if (!is.null(na.color) && col2rgb(na.color, alpha = TRUE)[[4]] == 
		    0) {
			na.color <- NULL
		}
		if (type != "numeric" && !missing(bins)) 
			warning("'bins' is ignored because the palette type is not numeric")
		if (type == "numeric") {
			cuts <- if (length(bins) == 1) 
				pretty(values, bins)
			else bins	
			
			if (length(bins) > 2) 
				if (!all(abs(diff(bins, differences = 2)) <= 
				         sqrt(.Machine$double.eps))) 
					stop("The vector of breaks 'bins' must be equally spaced")
			n <- length(cuts)
			r <- range(values, na.rm = TRUE)
			cuts <- cuts[cuts >= r[1] & cuts <= r[2]]
			n <- length(cuts)
			p <- (cuts - r[1])/(r[2] - r[1])
			extra <- list(p_1 = p[1], p_n = p[n])
			p <- c("", paste0(100 * p, "%"), "")
			if (decreasing == TRUE){
				colors <- pal(rev(c(r[1], cuts, r[2])))
				labels <- rev(labFormat(type = "numeric", cuts))
			}else{
				colors <- pal(c(r[1], cuts, r[2]))
				labels <- rev(labFormat(type = "numeric", cuts))
			}
			colors <- paste(colors, p, sep = " ", collapse = ", ")
			
		}
		else if (type == "bin") {
			cuts <- args$bins
			n <- length(cuts)
			mids <- (cuts[-1] + cuts[-n])/2
			if (decreasing == TRUE){
				colors <- pal(rev(mids))
				labels <- rev(labFormat(type = "bin", cuts))
			}else{
				colors <- pal(mids)
				labels <- labFormat(type = "bin", cuts)
			}
			
		}
		else if (type == "quantile") {
			p <- args$probs
			n <- length(p)
			cuts <- quantile(values, probs = p, na.rm = TRUE)
			mids <- quantile(values, probs = (p[-1] + p[-n])/2, 
				 na.rm = TRUE)
			if (decreasing == TRUE){
				colors <- pal(rev(mids))
				labels <- rev(labFormat(type = "quantile", cuts, p))
			}else{
				colors <- pal(mids)
				labels <- labFormat(type = "quantile", cuts, p)
			}
		}
		else if (type == "factor") {
			v <- sort(unique(na.omit(values)))
			colors <- pal(v)
			labels <- labFormat(type = "factor", v)
			if (decreasing == TRUE){
				colors <- pal(rev(v))
				labels <- rev(labFormat(type = "factor", v))
			}else{
				colors <- pal(v)
				labels <- labFormat(type = "factor", v)
			}
		}
		else stop("Palette function not supported")
		if (!any(is.na(values))) 
			na.color <- NULL
	}
	else {
		if (length(colors) != length(labels)) 
			stop("'colors' and 'labels' must be of the same length")
	}
	legend <- list(colors = I(unname(colors)), labels = I(unname(labels)), 
	               na_color = na.color, na_label = na.label, opacity = opacity, 
	               position = position, type = type, title = title, extra = extra, 
	               layerId = layerId, className = className, group = group)
	invokeMethod(map, data, "addLegend", legend)
}
```

```{r identify_closest_stations, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, eval=isTRUE(get0("has_weather", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = FALSE))}
# Process the station and weather data (skipped when weather.parquet is empty).
n_stations=3 # number of stations to show
  # Get data for closest weather stations
  
    cent <- suppressWarnings( focal_park %>%
                                st_union()%>%
                                st_centroid())
    # stations.gpkg is WGS84; park polygons may be projected — force a shared CRS.
    shared_crs <- sf::st_crs(cent)
    if (is.na(shared_crs)) {
      shared_crs <- sf::st_crs(4326)
    }
    cent <- sf::st_transform(cent, shared_crs)
    stations_aligned <- sf::st_transform(stations, shared_crs)
    
    closest_stations <- 
      data.frame(station = stations_aligned$STNID,
                 name = stations_aligned$NAME,
               distance = as.numeric(st_distance(cent, stations_aligned)))
    
    closest_stations <- closest_stations[order(closest_stations$distance),]
    
    closest_stations <- closest_stations$station[1:n_stations]

  #Hack in case some of the files aren't downloaded correctly.
```

```{r reformat_to_match_noaa, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, eval=isTRUE(get0("has_weather", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = FALSE))}

  # emma_envdata@weather_data/weather.parquet schema (§0.2 / R1):
  # STNID, YEARMODA (Date), TEMP (°C), PRCP (mm), NAME — not GSODR YEAR/MONTH/DAY.

  focal_weather %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      yearmoda_date = as.Date(.data$YEARMODA),
      year = as.integer(format(.data$yearmoda_date, "%Y")),
      month = as.integer(format(.data$yearmoda_date, "%m")),
      day = as.integer(format(.data$yearmoda_date, "%d")),
      station_name = .data$NAME,
      mean_precip_mm = .data$PRCP,
      temp_c = .data$TEMP,
      date_time = as.POSIXct(.data$yearmoda_date, tz = "UTC")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$date_time)) -> focal_weather

  has_weather <- is.data.frame(focal_weather) && nrow(focal_weather) >= 1L
  if (!has_weather) {
    message("Weather rows failed YEARMODA reformat; skipping climate figures")
    if (inherits(stations, "sf")) {
      focal_stations_sf <- stations[FALSE, , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }
```

```{r generate_precip_dataset, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, eval=isTRUE(get0("has_weather", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = FALSE))}
library(zoo)
# Set the rolling window size (must be odd for centering)
window_size <- 61  # e.g., ±15 days = 31 total

# Step 1: Prepare the daily data
focal_precip <- focal_weather %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_precip_mm)) %>%
  select(station_name,date_time,mean_precip_mm) %>%
  mutate(date_time = as_date(date_time)) %>%
#  filter(date_time > as_date("2000-01-01")) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = station_name,
    values_from = mean_precip_mm,
    values_fn = mean
  ) %>%
  mutate(doy = yday(date_time))

# Step 2: Compute the daily climatology using all years
# Average across stations by DOY
focal_precip_climatology <- focal_precip %>%
  group_by(doy) %>%
  summarise(clim_mean = mean(c_across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(doy)

# Step 3: Apply rolling mean (wrap around to handle year start/end)
# Pad the data for wrap-around
extended <- bind_rows(
  focal_precip_climatology %>% filter(doy > (366 - window_size)),
  focal_precip_climatology,
  focal_precip_climatology %>% filter(doy <= window_size)
)

# Compute the rolling mean twice to smooth it out
extended$roll_mean <- zoo::rollmean(extended$clim_mean, k = window_size, fill = NA, align = "center") |> 
  zoo::rollmean(k = window_size, fill = NA, align = "center")

# Step 4: Remove padding and match back to original DOY
rolling_climatology <- extended %>%
  slice((window_size + 1):(n() - window_size)) %>%
  select(doy, mean = roll_mean)

# Step 5: Join back to the daily weather data
focal_precip %>%
  left_join(rolling_climatology, by = "doy") %>%
  select(-doy) %>%
   xts::xts(x=select(.,-date_time), order.by = .$date_time) -> focal_precip


# calculate monthly totals
  bind_cols(date_time=time(focal_precip),as.data.frame(focal_precip)) |> 
    mutate(year=year(as_date(date_time)),month=month(as_date(date_time))) |> 
    pivot_longer(-c(date_time,month,year),names_to="station",values_to="precip") |> 
    group_by(station,year,month) |> 
      summarize(precip=sum(precip,na.omit=T)) |> 
      arrange(station,year,month) |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    mutate(date_time=ymd(paste(year,month,15))) |> 
    select(-year,-month) |> 
    pivot_wider(id_cols="date_time",names_from=station,values_from=precip)-> 
    focal_precip_monthly
  
  focal_precip_monthly_xts <- xts::xts(x=select(focal_precip_monthly,-date_time), order.by = focal_precip_monthly$date_time)
```

```{r generate_temp_dataset, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, eval=isTRUE(get0("has_weather", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = FALSE))}

    #mean daily temp dataset

  focal_weather%>%
  group_by(station_name,year,month,day)%>%
  summarise(daily_temp_C = mean(na.omit(temp_c)))%>%
  ungroup() %>%
mutate(date_time = paste(year,month,day,sep = "-"))%>%
  mutate(date_time = strptime(date_time,format = "%Y-%m-%d"))%>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(date_time))%>%
  dplyr::select(date_time,station_name, daily_temp_C) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = daily_temp_C,
              names_from = station_name,
              values_fn = mean) %>%
   mutate(doy =  lubridate::yday(date_time) ) %>%
   left_join(x=.,
             y  = group_by(., doy) %>%
               summarize(mean = mean(c_across(!contains(c("doy","date_time"))),
                                         na.rm=TRUE))
             ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-doy)%>%
    xts::xts(order.by = .$date_time) -> focal_mean_daily_temp
```

```{r crop invasives, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

# Empty iNat (CSV seed / Actions / API downtime): never call addCircleMarkers on zero rows.
has_inat <- inherits(inat_data, "sf") && nrow(inat_data) >= 1L

if (has_inat) {
  inat_data %>%
    filter(invasive == TRUE &
             as_date(observed_on) > (today() - as.difftime(900, units = "days"))) |>
    st_crop(y = focal_wgs %>% st_buffer(dist = 1000)) -> focal_invasives

  inat_data %>%
    filter(invasive == TRUE &
             as_date(observed_on) <= (today() - as.difftime(900, units = "days"))) |>
    st_crop(y = focal_wgs %>% st_buffer(dist = 1000)) -> focal_old_invasives
} else {
  message("No iNaturalist invasives loaded; skipping invasive markers for this park")
  focal_invasives <- inat_data
  focal_old_invasives <- inat_data
}

has_focal_invasives <- inherits(focal_invasives, "sf") && nrow(focal_invasives) >= 1L
invasive_labels <- if (has_focal_invasives) {
  focal_invasives$scientific_name
} else {
  NULL
}
```

```{r evi_and_burns, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
park_map <- leaflet(data = focal_wgs) %>%
  addProviderTiles("Esri.NatGeoWorldMap", group = "NatGeo") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "World Imagery") %>%
  addPolygons(
    color = "black",
    stroke = TRUE,
    fill = FALSE,
    group = "Park"
  ) %>%
  addRasterImage(
    x = raster::raster(most_recent_evi.tif),
    group = "EVI",
    colors = evi_pal
  ) %>%
  addRasterImage(
    x = raster::raster(monthly_delta_evi.tif),
    group = "delta EVI<br/>(monthly)",
    colors = delta_evi_pal
  ) %>%
  addRasterImage(
    x = raster::raster(delta_evi.tif),
    group = "delta EVI<br/>(long-term)",
    colors = delta_evi_pal
  ) %>%
  addRasterImage(
    x = raster::raster(years_since_fire.tif),
    group = "Years since fire",
    colors = years_since_fire_pal,
    opacity = 0.7
  ) %>%
  hideGroup("delta EVI<br/>(quarterly)")

  )

# Empty/partial weather: skip station markers (same failure mode as empty iNat).
has_focal_stations <- inherits(focal_stations_sf, "sf") && nrow(focal_stations_sf) >= 1L
if (isTRUE(has_focal_stations)) {
  station_labels <- if ("station_name" %in% names(focal_stations_sf)) {
    focal_stations_sf$station_name
  } else if ("NAME" %in% names(focal_stations_sf)) {
    focal_stations_sf$NAME
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  park_map <- park_map %>%
    addMarkers(
      data = focal_stations_sf,
      label = station_labels,
      group = "Stations"
    )
}

park_map <- park_map %>%
  hideGroup("Stations") %>%
  hideGroup("EVI") %>%
  hideGroup("delta EVI<br/>(long-term)") %>%
  hideGroup("Years since fire") %>%
  hideGroup("Fires")

if (isTRUE(has_focal_invasives)) {
  park_map <- park_map %>% hideGroup("Invasives (new)")
}

overlay_groups <- c(
  "Park",
  "Stations",
  "delta EVI<br/>(monthly)",
  "delta EVI<br/>(long-term)",
  "EVI",
  "Years since fire",
  "Fire Outlines",
  "Fires"
)
if (isTRUE(has_focal_invasives)) {
  overlay_groups <- c(overlay_groups, "Invasives (new)")
}

park_map %>%
  leaflet::addLegend(
    position = "topright",
    pal = delta_evi_pal,
    values = ~values(monthly_delta_evi.tif),
    opacity = 1,
    title = "delta<br/>EVI"
  ) %>%
  leaflet::addLegend(
    position = "topright",
    pal = evi_pal,
    values = ~values(raster::raster(most_recent_evi.tif)),
    opacity = 1,
    title = "EVI"
  ) %>%
  addLegend_decreasing(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = ~fires_wgs_truncated$Years,
    title = "Years<br/>Since<br/>Fire",
    opacity = 1
  ) %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("NatGeo", "World Imagery"),
    overlayGroups = overlay_groups,
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE),
    position = "topleft"
  ) %>%
  fitBounds(bbox[1], bbox[2], bbox[3], bbox[4])

```

Figure 1. Leaflet map showing monthly and long-term delta EVI, current EVI, years since the most recent fire (raster + outlines), and recent invasive species records (small green leaves). Multi-sensor EVI uses a VIIRS→Terra→Aqua fill (NOAA-20 → S-NPP → Terra → Aqua; first non-NA wins). NA in EVI / delta layers means all available sensors were missing after QA (e.g. water, cloud, snow). Monthly delta EVI is the fused latest composite minus the fuse-then-mean for the same calendar month; long-term delta uses the fuse-then-mean over all available composite dates. EVI data are from `r most_recent_evi_date` (STAC multi-sensor COGs). Fire age is derived from [`fireage_current.tif`](https://github.com/eco-emma/emma_envdata/releases/download/fireage/fireage_current.tif). The filled fire polygon color scale is truncated at 20 years for readability; hover labels and the years-since-fire raster use true ages. Right-censored / never-burned pixels are not collapsed to age 20 (see Fig. 2).

## Area burned and vegetation ages

```{r vegetation ages over time, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

# Subset park_fire_history to only the focal park

  # use the evi raster as a template to get cells in park

    most_recent_evi.tif %>%
      terra::extract(y = vect(focal_park),
                     cells = TRUE,
                     touches = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(cell) -> focal_cells

  # ~500 m domain cells → hectares (EPSG:9221 metres)
  cell_ha <- as.numeric(
    terra::cellSize(most_recent_evi.tif, unit = "ha")[1]
  )
  if (!is.finite(cell_ha) || cell_ha <= 0) {
    cell_ha <- prod(terra::res(most_recent_evi.tif)) / 1e4
  }

  # Keep age + censor fields. fire_count == 0 / NA last_burn_date ⇒ right-censored
  # (envdata lower-bounds age at record start 2000-01-01). Do not collapse to 20.

  park_fire_history_focal <- park_fire_history %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$cellID %in% focal_cells$cell)

  if (!"last_burn_date" %in% names(park_fire_history_focal)) {
    park_fire_history_focal$last_burn_date <- NA_real_
  }
  if (!"fire_count" %in% names(park_fire_history_focal)) {
    park_fire_history_focal$fire_count <- NA_real_
  }

  focal_fires <-
    park_fire_history_focal %>%
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::any_of(c(
        "cellID", "date", "days_since_fire", "last_burn_date", "fire_count"
      ))
    ) %>%
    # Multiple sensors/sources can share cellID+date; keep youngest known age.
    dplyr::group_by(.data$cellID, .data$date) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      days_since_fire = suppressWarnings(min(.data$days_since_fire, na.rm = TRUE)),
      last_burn_date = suppressWarnings(max(.data$last_burn_date, na.rm = TRUE)),
      fire_count = suppressWarnings(max(.data$fire_count, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      days_since_fire = dplyr::if_else(
        is.infinite(.data$days_since_fire),
        NA_real_,
        .data$days_since_fire
      ),
      last_burn_date = dplyr::if_else(
        is.infinite(.data$last_burn_date),
        NA_real_,
        .data$last_burn_date
      ),
      fire_count = dplyr::if_else(
        is.infinite(.data$fire_count),
        NA_real_,
        .data$fire_count
      ),
      censored = is.na(.data$last_burn_date) |
        (!is.na(.data$fire_count) & .data$fire_count <= 0)
    )

  if (nrow(focal_fires) == 0) {
    fire_dates <- unique(park_fire_history$date)
    if (length(fire_dates) < 1L) {
      fire_dates <- as.Date(character())
    }
    focal_fires <- expand.grid(
      cellID = focal_cells$cell,
      date = fire_dates,
      days_since_fire = NA_real_,
      last_burn_date = NA_real_,
      fire_count = NA_real_,
      censored = TRUE,
      KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  # True ages for known burns only (no unknown→20 collapse)
  ff2 <- focal_fires %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      years_since_fire = .data$days_since_fire / 365.25,
      date = lubridate::as_date(.data$date),
      year = lubridate::year(.data$date)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      years_since_fire = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(.data$years_since_fire) | .data$years_since_fire < 0,
        NA_real_,
        .data$years_since_fire
      )
    )

  censored_summary <- ff2 %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$year) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n = dplyr::n(),
      n_censored = sum(.data$censored, na.rm = TRUE),
      fraction_censored = .data$n_censored / .data$n,
      age_max = {
        known_ages <- .data$years_since_fire[!.data$censored &
          is.finite(.data$years_since_fire)]
        if (length(known_ages) < 1L) {
          0
        } else {
          max(known_ages, na.rm = TRUE)
        }
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(label_x = pmax(.data$age_max, 1))

  ff_known <- ff2 %>%
    dplyr::filter(!.data$censored, is.finite(.data$years_since_fire)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(year = as.factor(.data$year))

  if (nrow(ff_known) >= 1L) {
    p1 <- ggplot(
      ff_known,
      mapping = aes(
        x = years_since_fire,
        y = year,
        fill = after_stat(x)
      )
    ) +
      ggridges::geom_density_ridges_gradient() +
      labs(fill = "Age") +
      xlab("Vegetation age (years, known burns)") +
      ylab("Year") +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none") +
      geom_text(
        data = censored_summary,
        aes(
          label = paste0(round(fraction_censored * 100), "% censored"),
          y = as.factor(year),
          x = label_x
        ),
        position = position_nudge(x = 0.5),
        hjust = 0,
        size = 3,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +
      scale_y_discrete(expand = c(.05, 0.2)) +
      coord_flip()
  } else {
    p1 <- ggplot() +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = 0.5,
        y = 0.5,
        label = "No known-burn age records in this window"
      ) +
      theme_void()
  }

  # Calendar-year burned area from year(last_burn_date) on the latest snapshot
  latest_fire_date <- suppressWarnings(max(ff2$date, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (is.finite(latest_fire_date)) {
    area_by_year <- ff2 %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$date == latest_fire_date,
        !is.na(.data$last_burn_date),
        !.data$censored
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        burn_year = lubridate::year(lubridate::as_date(.data$last_burn_date))
      ) %>%
      dplyr::count(.data$burn_year, name = "n_cells") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(area_ha = .data$n_cells * cell_ha) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(.data$burn_year)
  } else {
    area_by_year <- tibble::tibble(
      burn_year = integer(),
      n_cells = integer(),
      area_ha = numeric()
    )
  }

  if (nrow(area_by_year) < 1L || sum(area_by_year$n_cells, na.rm = TRUE) < 1L) {
    p_burnedarea <- ggplot() +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = 0.5,
        y = 0.5,
        label = "No burns recorded in this window"
      ) +
      theme_void() +
      ggtitle("Area burned (calendar year)")
  } else {
    year_breaks <- seq(
      min(area_by_year$burn_year, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(area_by_year$burn_year, na.rm = TRUE),
      by = 1
    )
    p_burnedarea <- ggplot(
      area_by_year,
      aes(x = burn_year, y = area_ha)
    ) +
      geom_col(width = 0.8, fill = "firebrick") +
      ylab("Area burned (ha)") +
      xlab("") +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = year_breaks) +
      theme_bw() +
      ggtitle("Area burned (calendar year of last burn)")
  }

  plot_grid(
    p_burnedarea,
    p1,
    ncol = 1,
    align = "v",
    labels = "AUTO",
    rel_heights = c(0.3, 0.7),
    label_size = 0
  )

```

Figure 2. Top: Calendar-year burned area in the park from each cell's `last_burn_date` on the latest fireage snapshot (hectares; domain cell area × cell count). Empty panels show “No burns recorded in this window” when no known burns fall in the history. Bottom: Ridgeplot of **true** vegetation ages for cells with a known burn. Percentages label the share of park cells that are right-censored / never-burned in the satellite+agency record (not assigned a fake age of 20). Ages older than 20 years appear when the data support them.
